hook.line: The fewest clues a sudoku can have and still have a single solution — proven by an exhaustive computer search in 2012.
hook.say: Let’s solve the history of sudoku together!

p: Its roots lie in the Latin squares studied by the 18th-century mathematician Euler.
It appeared as “Number Place” in an American puzzle magazine in 1979; Japan’s Nikoli named it “Sudoku” in 1984. When The Times ran it in 2004, a worldwide craze began.
